title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.13
exact_target: Historical question: does omission of one by the differential monomial $f'f^n$ ensure normality for meromorphic disc functions when $n$ is at least three? The source update reports an affirmative answer.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2305013 (AMR-022-5013). CC BY 4.0.
W. K. Hayman and E. F. Lingham, Research Problems in Function Theory (2018), arXiv:1809.07200, Chapter 5, Problem 5.13, its update and the preceding shared notation.
